notes: YouTube videos loop without the pause. The usual way to loop an embedded video asks YouTube to start it over once it ends, which tears the player down and builds it again - that was the half second gap. The player is now told to jump back…
Measured on the real player: it now carries straight on through the wrap without ever leaving the playing state.

A short clip loops most smoothly, because its opening is already loaded. A very long video may still hesitate at the wrap, since jumping to the start of something hours long can mean fetching it again.
